sources.title: casperhansen/Qwen3.5-0.8B-INT-W8A8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-.8B-INT-W8A8 INT8 W8A8 quantization of Qwen/Qwen3.5-.8B, produced for development purposes with the simplest possible method: round-to-nearest (RTN) weights — no GPTQ, no calibration data.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-0.8B is the smallest member of the Qwen3.5 family — same hybrid gated delta networks architecture and 262K context, at a size suited to edge devices or as a draft model for speculative decoding with larger Qwen3.5 checkpoints.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B · LLM Releases
sources.snippet: The smallest Qwen3.5 model — a dense 0.8B designed for the most constrained on-device deployments, operating in non-thinking (instruct) mode by default. Apache-2.0, with native vision, a 262K-token context, and the family's hybrid thinking / non-thinking mode; needs roughly 2GB of VRAM and runs under 2GB at 4-bit, targeting smartphones and ...

sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-0.8B Ultra‑compact 0.8B parameter model from the Qwen3.5 series for edge deployment. Qwen3.5 is the latest multilingual language model series from Alibaba Cloud with improved reasoning and instruction‑following capabilities over Qwen3.
